description: This Kotlin source file defines internal functions related to network hostname analysis, specifically identifying loopback and private LAN gateway hosts in an Android environment. It includes utility functions for parsing IP addresses, checking runtime environment, and determining address types based on IP address bytes.

methods.name: isLoopbackGatewayHost
methods.description: Determines if a given hostname string refers to a loopback gateway host (local or emulator bridge).

methods.name: isPrivateLanGatewayHost
methods.description: Checks if a hostname refers to a private LAN gateway, including local and IPv4/IPv6 private ranges.
